page_title: EIN 4-1 FRE | Eintracht Frankfurt v Freiburg 14/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
88' Substitution. Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) in, Mario Gotze out.

85' The free kick from a promising distance is taken by Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the left post. What a chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
84' Sven Jablonski shows a yellow card to Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) for his blatant foul.
81' 4 - 1 Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds himself in a good shooting position after his nice solo run and pulls the trigger to direct the ball into the bottom left corner.
81' The substitution is prepared. Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rasmus Kristensen.
81' Substitution. Hugo Ekitike will be replaced by Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt).
80' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a change. Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Hugo Larsson.
80' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Eintracht Frankfurt was in an offside position.
78' Julian Schuster has decided to substitute Merlin Rohl and he is replaced by Junior Adamu (Freiburg).
78' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Lucas Holer walks off the pitch to be replaced by Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg).

77' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort low towards the middle of the goal, but Noah Atubolu pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
76' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
72' Here is a change. Nathaniel Brown is going off and Dino Toppmoller gives the last tactical orders to Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt).
71' 3 - 1 Goal! Mario Gotze slips a clever pass through to Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the roof of the net. 3:1.
69' Eintracht Frankfurt take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
68' The resulting set piece from Eintracht Frankfurt is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
67' Eintracht Frankfurt can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
66' The game has come to an end for Vincenzo Grifo. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg).
65' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

65' 2 - 1 Goal! Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 2:1.
62' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the top left corner. However, Kevin Trapp anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
60' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
56' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires a powerful volley towards goal, but his shot lacks accuracy and is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
55' Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
54' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings in a cross from the corner, but Noah Atubolu reads it well and gathers the ball.

54' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball goes behind for a corner. Eintracht Frankfurt will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
52' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) connects with the free kick and produces a header goalwards which is well blocked. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about that one.
51' Poor challenge! Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) is penalised for tripping and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Eintracht Frankfurt.

51' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his daisy-cutter towards the right post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it.
50' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

50' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Noah Atubolu anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. The ball is out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt manage to earn a corner.
48' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) trips an opposition player and Sven Jablonski signals a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Freiburg.

46' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) sprints into the box to get on the end of a cross and directs a shot goalwards that flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.

45+4' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
45+3' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. That's a free kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.

45+2' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
45+1' Sven Jablonski interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Lukas Kubler (Freiburg). Eintracht Frankfurt are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.

45' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.

43' 1 - 1 Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Omar Marmoush. His header was precise and ended up inside the right post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 1:1.
43' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
42' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) is able to continue to play.
40' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
40' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
39' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
37' 0 - 1 Goal! Merlin Rohl plays a simple square pass into the feet of Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
32' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
29' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a rough foul. Sven Jablonski stops the game and makes a call. Freiburg are awarded a free kick.
28' The yellow card goes to Matthias Ginter (Freiburg). The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Matthias Ginter (Freiburg).
26' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
25' Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
24' Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
23' The resulting corner from Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cleared.
23' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Eintracht Frankfurt get a corner.
21' One of the players from Eintracht Frankfurt times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
20' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) makes a strong challenge and Sven Jablonski blows for a foul. Eintracht Frankfurt get a free kick.
20' The corner is swung in but Eintracht Frankfurt can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
13' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot at goal. His effort is blocked by Noah Atubolu with a brilliant diving save!
12' Freiburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
11' That's unlucky! Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
10' Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Kevin Trapp has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.

3' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
1' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) is penalised for holding. Sven Jablonski signals a set piece. It's a free kick to Eintracht Frankfurt in a dangerous position.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Freiburg will kick the game off.
Sven Jablonski was nominated as the referee for this game.
